item.title: SuperTalk Eagle Hour 3/2/2026
item.description: Head USM baseball coach Christian Ostrander recaps weekend series sweep of LA Tech and looks ahead to Tuesday’s game with Mississippi State, Wednesday’s game with Nicholls and next weekend’s series with North Alabama. Plus, head softball coach Natalie Poole talks six straight wins!

item.title: T&L Extra: Dima Mixon of the Eagle Hour Previews Mississippi State-Southern Mississippi
item.description: Mississippi State heads to Hattiesburg Tuesday night for a top ten matchup with their instate rivals from Southern Mississippi. Brian Hadad welcomes Dima Mixon of Pine Belt Sports and the Eagle Hour to the pod to get a preview on the Golden Eagles.

item.title: Thunder & Lightning: Mississippi State’s Match Up With Southern Mississippi Might Be the Biggest Midweek Game Ever
item.description: Two bitter instate rivals going to head to head would make Mississippi State’s trip to Southern Mississippi interesting enough, but both teams ranked in the D1Baseball Top 10 has added another layer of drama to this already exciting game. Brian Hadad and Robbie Faulk get you set for Bulldogs-Golden Eagles in Hattiesburg Tuesday night.
